title: MSSM Higgs-boson mass predictions and two-loop non-supersymmetric counterterms
claim: For the Yukawa-enhanced two-loop MSSM Higgs-mass corrections (O(alpha_t,b alpha_s), O(alpha_t,b^2), O(alpha_t alpha_b), gaugeless limit) DRED preserves the needed SUSY: the relevant ST identity (fifth derivative of S(Gamma) w.r.t. three Higgs components, a Higgsino and the SUSY ghost) holds, so the non-supersymmetric two-loop quartic Higgs counterterm vanishes and multiplicative (symmetric) renormalization is justified.
scheme: DRED of S2.10 with anticommuting gamma5.
symmetry_argument: ST identity S(Gamma)=0 with constant SUSY ghost (eq. 7); its two-loop breaking rewritten as a single insertion [S(Gamma^(0))] (eq. 18, method of S2.10); gamma-matrix counting (properties after eq. 19) and momentum arguments (eq. 20) make all breaking diagrams vanish.

proved: Delta^(2),DRED = 0 for the identity of eqs. (8)-(10) at the stated orders (eq. 21), hence delta^(2) V^quartic_non-susy = 0 (eq. 22).

red_flags: Gamma counting fails once electroweak gauge couplings are included (vector bosons add gamma matrices); no straightforward extension to full electroweak two-loop or three-loop (Sec. 5).
